**Research methods:**
- Check Google Reviews and Yelp for roofers with high ratings and hail damage experience
- Ask your insurance company for recommended contractors
- Get multiple quotes (3-5) to compare
- Verify licensing through Colorado's Division of Professions

**What to look for:**
- Colorado roofing license and insurance
- Experience specifically with hail damage claims
- Willingness to work with your insurance adjuster

- Pressure to sign quickly
- Unwillingness to work with insurance
- No local references available
- Significantly lower prices than competitors
